title: ReleaseHarnessAuthoringRecord
description: How a draft's claims were arrived at. Separate from the draft itself so that 'what is proposed' and 'what was actually looked at' cannot be confused for one another. Never stores chain-of-thought, transcripts, or every command run -- only the claims and the evidence behind them.

authored_by.description: Who or what prepared this record. Attribution, not authorization -- an agent may prepare a record, but preparing one is not accepting it.

claim.description: What is being claimed, in plain words.

status.description: What is known about this claim. observed: directly read. observed_absent: a bounded search completed and found nothing. asserted_absent: a test or contract asserts nonexistence -- the assertion is the evidence. inferred: an interpretation, usable while drafting but not under an accepted assertion. not_established: the search never ran, failed, was killed, timed out, or returned truncated results -- supports nothing.

evidence.description: How the claim was arrived at. Which fields are REQUIRED depends on the claim's status; see the rules below. The set is closed so a misspelled field is reported rather than silently dropped.

completed.description: Whether the search ran to completion. Must be true to establish absence.

asserted_by.description: The test or contract that requires the thing not to exist.

contradiction.description: Sources that genuinely disagree, both recorded, neither chosen.

note.description: Free prose for a reader. Never a substitute for a citation.

superseded.description: A claim this one corrected. Retained so a reader can see that an earlier search was wrong and why.

evidence.description: The evidence the corrected claim rested on, retained so a reader can see why the earlier search was wrong.

allOf.description: A positive or inferred claim cites what was read.

An absence established by searching must carry the bounds of that search, and must state that the search completed. 'Not found' is a statement about the search until its scope and completion are known -- this is the single highest-recurrence defect the design research found.

completed.description: Must be true. A killed, timed-out or truncated search establishes nothing and belongs in not_established.

allOf.description: An asserted absence must cite the test or contract that asserts it; without a citation it is an inference wearing a stronger status.
